gen-gf-turret-road-work-sans: Work Sans reads contemporary, its c tips held well apart and its mean line sitting high on the letters. And Turret Road leads with round, bold forms drawn like open parentheses, a pen-like line that never changes weight.
gen-gf-underdog-archivo: Underdog draws every curve without a shift in weight, its c opened wide like a horseshoe. But Archivo, with its commanding x-height and curves that open outward, makes a longer passage feel approachable and editorial.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-asap: Asap reads as a sans whose body height nearly matches its capitals, with open arcs for its c forms. Underdog's horseshoe curves make the stronger contrast.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Expressive is the first word for Underdog, whose curves keep one weight and whose c opens like a horseshoe. And Be Vietnam Pro follows in clean, bent-rod strokes, so a body size a notch above usual would suit it.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-epilogue: Approachable is how Epilogue feels, with curvy, unclamped letters and a tall-bodied lowercase of stubby ascender tips. Epilogue's wire-like skeleton keeps a long page light, a nice foil for Underdog's commanding horseshoe c.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-fira-sans: Underdog's curves never thicken or thin, and its c gapes open like a horseshoe. And Fira Sans, a plain sans with a larger-than-usual x-height, takes over the text with s curves open at both ends.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-merriweather-sans: Underdog's bowls never thin at the sides. Merriweather Sans is the one built for text, its tall lowercase making words look sturdy while the e opens clearly to the right.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-public-sans: Bold, hefty, a little bent-straw quirky: that is Underdog up top. Public Sans carries the text as a plain sans with a sturdy lowercase, so a slightly generous size lets its broad counters breathe.
gen-gf-underdog-fs-supreme: Underdog's thin-looking letters have no thinner parts at all, and its c opens wide like a horseshoe. Supreme answers underneath with a heavy, crisp strip of sans text, so the two feel like a loud voice and a firm one.
gen-gf-underdog-general-sans: General Sans keeps a steady pen pressure from first letter to last. Underdog shines at expressive, commanding display lines, while the sans below fills each line with a tall x-height and smooth, unobstructed bends.
